player_prompt.intro:
O wena Ke Moshomi {player_id} mo papading ya {num_rounds} ya Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Tlhagiso ya gago ke go fenya dipapadi tse dintsi ka kgonego.
Mo papading nngwe le nngwe, araba ka nngwe ya: '[rock]', '[paper]', kana '[scissors]'.
O ka dirisa '[r]', '[p]', kana '[s]' e le mokwalo o motlho.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsheko ya gago ha e utlwisiswa. Dirisanya [rock], [paper], kana [scissors].

message.round_win: Poelo ya motshameko: Motshameki {winner} o a fenya!

outcome.p0_wins: Motshameki 0 o ne a fenya metshameko e le mentsi!
outcome.p1_wins: Motshameki wa ntlha o ne a fenya metshameko e le mentsi!
